value.name: asha demands objections on the record
value.description: Asha insists that any objections be raised immediately in the room rather than later in a filing.
evidence: "I want to walk through this once on the record, in front of all of you, so that if any of you intends to object, you object now, in this room, and not later, in a filing."

value.name: daniel declines to object
value.description: Daniel looks to his sister and then tells Asha he does not intend to object.
evidence: Daniel looked at his sister. Lucia looked at her brother. Then they both looked back at Asha, and Daniel said, "I do not intend to object."

value.name: lucia declines to object
value.description: Lucia likewise states that she does not intend to object.

value.name: asha questions rosa about the codicil
value.description: Asha clarifies that Rosa is only a witness and asks her to confirm the filed document matches what her employer signed.
evidence: "Rosa, you are not a beneficiary under the codicil. You are a witness to it. I am not asking you to assent. I am asking whether, to your memory, the document we filed is the document your employer signed in your presence on the date it bears."

value.name: rosa verifies the filed document
value.description: Rosa confirms that the filed document is the one her employer signed in her presence.

value.name: asha moves to the appraisal
value.description: After confirming the codicil, Asha advances the meeting to the next item, the appraisal.
evidence: "Thank you. We will move to item two."

value.name: appraisal surprises the siblings
value.description: The house appraisal lands between Daniel's hopes and Lucia's fears, suggesting to them that it is honest.
evidence: The house had come in higher than Daniel had hoped and lower than Lucia had feared, which Asha had told them, privately, the week before, was usually a sign that the appraisal was honest.

value.name: siblings react to appraisal value
value.description: Daniel and Lucia physically react to the appraisal number, revealing their differing emotional stakes.
evidence: The number sat on the page between them now like a small piece of furniture they had to walk around.
Daniel reached for his coffee and did not drink from it.
Lucia put her hand flat on the page, briefly, as if the number were warm.

value.name: asha reads codicil property terms
value.description: Asha explains that the codicil leaves the house to Lucia, gives Daniel a one-third charge payable later, and grants Rosa a life tenancy in the third-floor rooms.
evidence: "The codicil," Asha said, "leaves the house to Lucia, with a charge upon the property in favor of Daniel in the amount of one-third of the appraised value, payable on a schedule we will discuss in item four. It also provides a life tenancy in the third-floor rooms to Rosa, terminable only at her election."

value.name: estate residue division is introduced
value.description: Asha begins explaining that the remaining estate will be divided equally after debts and taxes.
evidence: "The residue of the estate, after debts and taxes, divides equally
